amend.upstream.description: resolve the open findings while the context check is not valid: a finding that changes no scope takes its default decision (an agent, recorded as an assumption with its reason), a scope-changing one waits for a person's decision; the decision amends the questions and the requirements list (new revisions), and a vision that cites an amended requirement is set aside, so Canon re-derives the context check, the vision and the roadmap approval

context.approve.description: a person approves the current context revision

context.change.description: change one context assumption; moves the context to a new revision

context.default.description: fill every context field from the requirements list or its default, each recorded as an assumption; moves the context to a new revision; not once the current context revision is approved (a person changes an approved context with context.change)

roadmap.approve.description: a person approves the current roadmap revision, not while a finding is open

roadmap.write.description: write the roadmap naming its epics; moves the roadmap to a new revision; not once the current roadmap revision is approved

vision.approve.description: a person approves the current vision revision, not while a finding is open

vision.write.description: write the vision with `aep plan artifact new vision`; moves the vision to a new revision; not once the current vision revision is approved

context.description: context.yaml: audience, source and target language, platform and operating systems, kind of thing (service, multi-tenant application, CLI, library), deployment and licence, each with its status default, accepted or changed

findings.description: findings.yaml: the typed findings (ambiguity, contradiction, missing decision) any stage raised, each citing the items it conflicts with, with its status and its resolution

questions.description: the interview from sdc.intake, amended by resolved findings

roadmap.description: the roadmap, the outermost planning structure, naming the epics; AEP 0.80.0 has no roadmap kind, so it is an AEP initiative

vision.description: the vision document, an AEP vision artifact

context.approved.description: the current context revision is approved

context.valid.description: the current context is valid, derived from the current requirements list

roadmap.approved.description: the current roadmap revision is approved, against the current vision revision

roadmap.valid.description: the current roadmap validates in the planning store

vision.approved.description: the current vision revision is approved

context_approval.description: a person's approval of a context revision; its result is approved

context_defaults.description: the context check: schema-valid, every field present and recorded as an assumption with its status, no consistency rule firing between the context and the requirements list, and no open finding; its result is valid, invalid or finding

roadmap_approval.description: a person's approval of a roadmap revision; its result is approved

roadmap_validation.description: the result of `aep plan artifact validate` over the store holding the vision and the roadmap, valid or invalid

vision_approval.description: a person's approval of a vision revision; its result is approved

requirements.revised.description: a context check observed against an earlier requirements list no longer applies

vision.revised.description: a roadmap approval given against an earlier vision revision no longer applies

context.required.description: the context is valid and approved

roadmap.required.description: the roadmap is valid and approved

passed.description: the context, the vision and the roadmap are valid and approved

protocol.description: Fix the project context, the vision and the roadmap (docs/phases.md steps 4 to 6). Every project context default (audience, source and target language, platform and operating systems, kind of thing, deployment and licence) is recorded as an assumption and checked; the context, the vision and the roadmap are each approved by a person. An approval is a record bound to the revision it approved, produced only by an action that needs the authority owner.approve. A revised requirements list invalidates the context check; a revised vision invalidates the roadmap approval. The case ends passed once the roadmap is approved; nothing about epics or specifications happens before that. Late findings (docs/trial-2.md, "The late-finding loop"): the context check also runs the consistency rules of the context against the requirements list and reads the open findings, and is not valid while one is open; no vision or roadmap is written or approved then. amend.upstream resolves an open finding by amending the questions and the requirements list, which moves the requirements to a new revision, so the context check is observed again.
